THE RHYTHM OF A SIEGE

Make a plan.
Then fight for it.

Siege at Sundown brings fortress building and direct hero combat into the same 1v1 match. Every choice comes with you into battle.

DAYLIGHT IS AN OPPORTUNITY.
01 / PREPARE

Spend your coins.
Shape your siege.

Hunt neutral enemies, grow your income and build your fortress. Put gold into tomorrow's economy or today's army. Sunset makes the decision count.

Choose your hero ↗

the front.
